added_spoken.what: 'das ist so, wir müssen damit leben'; 'Mathematiker mögen diese Notation nicht, Physiker lieben diese Notation, das ist der Unterschied zwischen Mathematikern und Physikern'
the two extra symbols bring an advantage that is not yet obvious; the explanation will come
some calculation rules are implicit in the notation
'|e_0> steht für diesen Vektor, so soll man diese Gleichung lesen'; insert the columns to see which vector is represented
|e_±> appear in angular momentum, hydrogen and spin systems (left out: no written source, G-0072 (a))
later lectures drop the columns; at the beginning always insert them; many such calculations in the exercises
'wenn man diese komischen Symbole sieht, muss man dieses Objekt als einen Zeilenvektor verstehen'
bracket, bra, ket, the lost c; Dirac introduced the notation, used universally
no new definition, a new notation for the same objects and equations; three notations for one quantity; the two expressions are identified
in infinite dimension one cannot write a vector down completely; ket notation and the rule are the way to calculate efficiently
'trotzdem verwende ich diese Notation in zwei Dimensionen, weil sie sehr schön mit Operatoren und Matrizen zusammenspielt'; 'ab 5, 6, 7 Dimensionen' (number left out, G-0072 (c))
once you master the ket notation you can read the equations; 'Ket steht für Vektor'

'ich habe ein Beispiel von Skalarprodukt immer verwendet, aber es gibt unendlich viele'; 'für immer und ewig in der Physik'; flexibility; a vector space can exist without an inner product; 'nicht kanonisch'
not every such assignment counts as an inner product
the rules hold in finite and infinite dimension; therefore notation and concept are important
the norm is often written simply as the modulus of psi
completeness: very important but subtle, not relevant for the lecture, calculations simplify by ignoring it; 'ein Hilbertraum ist nichts anderes als ein komplexer Vektorraum mit Skalarprodukt'
'diese Positivitätsbedingungen sind sehr stark, die haben sehr schöne Folgen'; conjugate symmetry 'nichts Neues' for the examples
Schwarz inequality 'extrem schön', allows to prove the Heisenberg relation, particularly useful in quantum mechanics, holds for all phi, psi

the triangle inequality is proved with the Schwarz inequality (the spoken example 'to bound the energy of a system' is not kept: no source or derivation gives the bound; evidence/derivations/c03/REVIEW-lec3.md, B, row UNSUPPORTED)
orthogonality as in three dimensions; a vanishing inner product does not mean a vector is zero
the norm as a length; the vectors live in an abstract space, still helpful to read them as lengths
'diese Eigenschaften werden wir quasi ständig verwenden'; the Schwarz inequality is the most important, coupled to Heisenberg's inequality (the exam remark is left out)
a basis: vectors with nice properties along which all others decompose; one chooses a basis and calculates in it
'verwirrenderweise sagen wir, dass diese Basis vollständig ist; das hat gar nichts zu tun mit der Vollständigkeit von gestern'; two deltas in quantum mechanics
the qubit basis e_0, e_1 checked: four inner products, n^2 equations ('quasi n^2 durch zwei'; the chapter says j <= k suffice), completeness for psi = alpha e_0 + beta e_1
'wenn Sie ein bisschen Langeweile haben'; a system chosen arbitrarily normally is no basis
the expansion 'sieht harmlos aus, aber wir wenden diese Gleichung ständig an'; a form of the completeness relation
in finite dimension there is always a basis (1,0,...), (0,1,...); in infinite dimension existence must be proved, very hard; assumed from now on
'dieses Orthonormierungsverfahren liefert uns immer eine Basis' (not adopted: needs the condition of vl03.tex:221; G-0072 (d)); the input vectors are completely arbitrary

all quantities are computable; the scalar written to the right of the vector ('in der Definition stand immer an der linken Seite ... aber Sie müssen damit leben'); n has nothing to do with the dimension
terms with Psi_k = 0 are left out because of division by zero; some Psi_n can be zero
the procedure is helpful but has several parts and can be confusing; 'mein Lieblings-Hilbertraum C^2'; vectors 'gerade ausgedacht'
'es geht genauso, es wird nur aufwendiger'; it always works
